```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sigrecon)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

PROJECT_PATH <- file.path(Sys.getenv("MLAB"), "projects/brcameta/projects/sig_recon/")
RESULTS_PATH <- file.path(PROJECT_PATH, "results/eval/")
```

```{r}
summarize_method <- function(df, method_name){

  per_source <- df %>%
    group_by(source) %>%
    summarise(
      jacc_p = wilcox.test(jacc_TRUE, jacc_FALSE,
                           paired = TRUE,
                           alternative = "greater")$p.value,

      nes_p = wilcox.test(NES_TRUE, NES_FALSE,
                          paired = TRUE,
                          alternative = "greater")$p.value,

      jacc_prop = mean(jacc_TRUE > jacc_FALSE),
      nes_prop = mean(NES_TRUE > NES_FALSE),
      .groups="drop"
    )

  tibble(
    method = method_name,
    metric = c("Jaccard","NES"),
    fisher_p = c(
      fishers_meta_p(per_source$jacc_p),
      fishers_meta_p(per_source$nes_p)
    ),
    prop = c(
      mean(per_source$jacc_prop),
      mean(per_source$nes_prop)
    )
  )
}
```

# Tahoe {.tabset}

## Control {.tabset}
```{r}
tahoe_no_change_df <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "tahoe/no_change_eval_table.rds"))
tahoe_ctrl_mean_df <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "tahoe/ctrl_mean_eval_table.rds"))
tahoe_ctrl_net_df <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "tahoe/ctrl_networkprop_eval_table.rds"))
tahoe_ctrl_proj_e_df <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "tahoe/ctrl_projectcor_eigen_eval_table.rds"))
tahoe_ctrl_proj_g_df <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "tahoe/ctrl_projectcor_gsva_eval_table.rds"))
tahoe_orthos_df <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "tahoe/ctrl_orthos_residual_eval_table.rds"))
tahoe_stack_df <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "tahoe/stack_ctrl_eval_table.rds"))
```

```{r}
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  tahoe_no_change_df %>%
    transmute(drug = gene, method = "No change", jacc, NES),

  tahoe_ctrl_mean_df %>%
    transmute(drug = gene, method = "Mean", jacc = jacc_TRUE, NES = NES_TRUE),

  tahoe_ctrl_net_df %>%
    transmute(drug = gene, method = "NetworkProp", jacc = jacc_TRUE, NES = NES_TRUE),

  tahoe_ctrl_proj_e_df %>%
    transmute(drug = gene, method = "ProjectCor (Eigen)", jacc = jacc_TRUE, NES = NES_TRUE),

  tahoe_ctrl_proj_g_df %>%
    transmute(drug = gene, method = "ProjectCor (GSVA)", jacc = jacc_TRUE, NES = NES_TRUE),
  
  tahoe_orthos_df %>%
    transmute(drug = gene, method = "Orthos", jacc = jacc_TRUE, NES = NES_TRUE),
  
  tahoe_stack_df %>%
    transmute(drug = gene, method = "Stack", jacc = jacc_TRUE, NES = NES_TRUE),
)

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::rename(Jaccard = jacc) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Jaccard, NES), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")

saveRDS(plot_long, file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "tahoe/ctrl_unpaired_plot_df.rds"))

summary_df <- bind_rows(
  summarize_method(tahoe_ctrl_mean_df, "Mean"),
  summarize_method(tahoe_ctrl_net_df, "NetworkProp"),
  summarize_method(tahoe_ctrl_proj_e_df, "ProjectCor (Eigen)"),
  summarize_method(tahoe_ctrl_proj_g_df, "ProjectCor (GSVA)"),
  summarize_method(tahoe_orthos_df, "Orthos"),
  summarize_method(tahoe_stack_df, "Stack")
)
saveRDS(summary_df, file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "tahoe/ctrl_paired_plot_df.rds"))
```

### Unpaired
```{r}
baseline_means <- plot_long %>%
  filter(method == "No change") %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(yintercept = median(value), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(plot_long, aes(method, value, fill = method)) +
  geom_violin(
    width = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.3,
    color = NA,
    trim = TRUE
  ) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.15,
    size = 0.05,
    groupOnX = TRUE
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.5,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    data = baseline_means,
    aes(yintercept = yintercept),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("No change", "Mean", "NetworkProp", "ProjectCor (Eigen)",
               "ProjectCor (GSVA)", "Orthos", "Stack")
  ) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Score") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
```{r}
ggsave(file.path(PROJECT_PATH, "results/plots/tahoe_ctrl_unpaired.png"),
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 400
)
```

### Paired
```{r}
ggplot(summary_df,
       aes(x = -log10(fisher_p),
           y = method,
           size = prop,
           color = -log10(fisher_p))) +

  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +

  facet_wrap(~metric) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.02, 0.125)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    name = "-log10(meta p)",
    option = "A"
  ) +

  scale_size(
    range = c(3,10),
    name = "Fraction improved"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "-log10 Fisher meta‑p",
    y=""
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
ggsave(file.path(PROJECT_PATH, "results/plots/tahoe_ctrl_paired.png"),
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 400
)
```

## Trade
```{r}
trade_metrics_10th <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "tahoe/trade_metric_correlations/projectCor/10th_projectcor_eigen_trade_joined.rds"))
trade_metrics_10th
```
```{r}
ggplot(trade_metrics_10th, aes(x = TI, y = delta_NES)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_point(aes(color = gene), alpha = 0.72, size = 1.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.45) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "TI",
      y = "delta_NES",
      title = "TI vs delta NES (colored by perturbation)",
      color = "perturbation"
    )
```

```{r}

    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.35) +

    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.45) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
```

## 10th Results {.tabset}
```{r}
drugmatrix_no_change_df <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "drugmatrix/no_change_eval_table.rds"))
drugmatrix_ctrl_mean_df <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "drugmatrix/ctrl_10th_mean_eval_table.rds"))
drugmatrix_ctrl_net_df <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "drugmatrix/ctrl_10th_networkprop_eval_table.rds"))
drugmatrix_ctrl_proj_e_df <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "drugmatrix/10th_projectcor_eigen_eval_table.rds"))
drugmatrix_ctrl_proj_g_df <- readRDS(file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "drugmatrix/10th_projectcor_gsva_eval_table.rds"))
```

```{r}
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  drugmatrix_no_change_df %>%
    transmute(drug = gene, method = "No change", jacc, NES),

  drugmatrix_ctrl_mean_df %>%
    transmute(drug = gene, method = "Mean", jacc = jacc_TRUE, NES = NES_TRUE),

  drugmatrix_ctrl_net_df %>%
    transmute(drug = gene, method = "NetworkProp", jacc = jacc_TRUE, NES = NES_TRUE),

  drugmatrix_ctrl_proj_e_df %>%
    transmute(drug = gene, method = "ProjectCor (Eigen)", jacc = jacc_TRUE, NES = NES_TRUE),

  drugmatrix_ctrl_proj_g_df %>%
    transmute(drug = gene, method = "ProjectCor (GSVA)", jacc = jacc_TRUE, NES = NES_TRUE)
)

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::rename(Jaccard = jacc) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(drug, method) %>%
  dplyr::summarise_all(mean) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Jaccard, NES), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")

saveRDS(plot_long, file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "drugmatrix/ctrl_10th_unpaired_plot_df.rds"))

summary_df <- bind_rows(
  summarize_method(drugmatrix_ctrl_mean_df, "Mean"),
  summarize_method(drugmatrix_ctrl_net_df, "NetworkProp"),
  summarize_method(drugmatrix_ctrl_proj_e_df, "ProjectCor (Eigen)"),
  summarize_method(drugmatrix_ctrl_proj_g_df, "ProjectCor (GSVA)")
)
saveRDS(summary_df, file.path(RESULTS_PATH, "drugmatrix/ctrl_10th_paired_plot_df.rds"))
```

### Unpaired
```{r}
baseline_means <- plot_long %>%
  filter(method == "No change") %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(yintercept = median(value), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(plot_long, aes(method, value, fill = method)) +

  geom_violin(
    width = 0.9,
    alpha = 0.35,
    color = NA
  ) +

  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(
    size = 0.1,
    alpha = 0.7,
    cex = 0.7
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 21,
    size = 3,
    fill = "white"
  ) +

  geom_hline(
    data = baseline_means,
    aes(yintercept = yintercept),
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~metric,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +

  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("No change", "Mean", "NetworkProp", "ProjectCor (Eigen)", "ProjectCor (GSVA)")) + 
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Score"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
